catalog_authority: User-confirmed supplied CIS Controls Navigator workbook; CAS is a reference link, not a replacement authority.
method: Read all 153 workbook descriptions alongside every current checklist assertion. The manual source-completeness judgment is separate from automated raw-description identity, scope, count, ID uniqueness and persistence-bound checks.

source_boundary_corrections.7.1: Archive 7.1-c1/c2 unchanged; use 7.1-c3/c4 for established/maintained process and review/update documentation obligations.
source_boundary_corrections.4.12: Archive 4.12-c4/c5 unchanged; application/data separation remains implementation-example material in existing guidance, not distinct mandatory checks.
source_boundary_corrections.3.7: Archive 3.7-c5 unchanged; classification according to labels is an optional implementation sentence. Maintain the classification-scheme and review/update obligations.

resolved_authority_disputes.11.1: Workbook Worksheet!F88 governs; no mandatory detailed-backup-procedures addition.
resolved_authority_disputes.12.2: Workbook Worksheet!F94 governs; preserve exact example sentence and actual architecture with segmentation/least privilege/availability.
resolved_authority_disputes.17.5: Workbook Worksheet!F146 governs; no unconditional third-party-role category addition.

limitations: This is bounded source-content review, not client implementation verification or whole-framework assurance.
Independent licensing agreement verification remains outside this task.
Automated structural checks do not independently prove semantic correctness of all paraphrases.
